name: My Trucking Tacos
tagline: Authentic street-style Mexican food on Tamiami Trail in North Port.
about: My Trucking Tacos is a food truck serving authentic street-style Mexican food in North Port.
Find it at 14803a Tamiami Trail. Check Facebook for current hours and stops.
